verse.verse_1: When the earth is shaken with its violent shaking,
verse.verse_2: when the earth shakes off her burdens,
verse.verse_3: when man asks, "What is happening to her?";
verse.verse_4: on that Day it will narrate its account,
verse.verse_5: for your Lord has so directed it.
verse.verse_6: On that Day people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds:
verse.verse_7: whoever has done the smallest particle of good will see it;
verse.verse_8: while whoever has done the smallest particle of evil will see it.
